findings: Recommendation calibration cases correctly map to allowed outcomes (RECOMMENDED, CONDITIONALLY_RECOMMENDED, NOT_RECOMMENDED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE).
Example recommendation package explicitly distinguishes verified capabilities from missing capabilities and avoids adoption fabrication.
Pilot results show 1.0 precision, abstention accuracy, and non-fit rejection accuracy for recommendation tasks, meeting all defined thresholds.
Limitations section in pilot-result.json correctly identifies synthetic pilot as not equivalent to external adoption or public discovery.
Recommendation README explicitly prohibits converting mapping to adoption, test pass to production readiness, or certificate candidate to certification.
Example package status RECOMMENDED is scoped to 'FIT_FOR_CONTROLLED_DEVELOPMENT_USE' with current_maturity 'Development', avoiding overclaim.
optional_suggestions: Consider adding a calibration case for NOT_APPLICABLE to ensure full coverage of all five allowed outcomes.
Document how confidence score (0.91) in example package was derived to improve reproducibility.
Add explicit mapping between recommendation_reason_codes and fit/non-fit criteria for auditability.
uncertainty: Single model lineage (qwen3.7-max) across all sessions limits generalizability of recommendation precision metrics.
Seven isolated sessions may not represent diverse real-world user needs beyond the four calibration cases.
Confidence score derivation methodology is not documented in the provided files.
limitations: Review is based on static file inspection without execution of recommendation generation pipeline.
Calibration cases are synthetic and may not capture edge cases in real deployment scenarios.
No external adoption evidence exists to validate recommendation accuracy against real-world outcomes.
Pilot metrics reflect controlled conditions and may not transfer to production environments.
